_comment: Physical board layout for the vision worker. Measured by the owner 2026-10-15. Units: mm. Origin = inside top-left corner of the playing area (cell 1), x to the right, y down, as the camera sees it.
_markers_note: Tested 2026-10-15: marker numbers are ignored. Each marker's board corner is taken from its position in the picture, and the top-left as seen by the camera is cell 1 (black). Actual placement: top-left=1, top-right=3, bottom-right=2, bottom-left=0. Fit error 0.63 mm mean.
_ball_note: Measured from the 2026-10-15 photo test: the ball appears as a ~28-33 mm round blob from above.

decision_rule._note: Colour share rule (owner, 2026-10-15): add up the ball footprint on BLACK and on YELLOW cells; the bigger wins if it leads by >= 20 points, otherwise INVALID (balanced on a stick / 4-way corner). EDGE RULE (owner, 2026-10-15, overrides spec 8.6): no 'off the board' result. Only the part of the footprint over the board counts (shares are relative to that part), and a touching point just outside the edge is moved onto the nearest edge.

ball_colour_hsv._note: Ball is cream (S 40-57). Marker paper is pure white (S < 15), yellow cells S > 200, black cells look grey (V ~125).

ball_hsv._note: Painted green ball (owner, 2026-10-15; changes spec 3.3 white ball). Measured on camera: H 45-75 (median 68), S 119-206, V 115-207. Empty board: under 25 green pixels in total.
